$comment: The measured cost of the Sepolia curve epoch, derived from wallet balances. The estimate in scripts/test/sepolia-epoch-budget.ts predicted 0.0236 ETH from local gas figures; the real cost was 27% higher, which is the honest gap between a local measurement and a public network.
note: The provider funding itself is not a cost — it moved sideways and the remainder is recoverable with `pnpm dust:sweep`.
